Title: Impulse & reaction cards as the action is blocked

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
A is controlled by the acting Methuselah, B is controlled by his prey and is tapped.
A bleeds (0 stealth). A passes. B plays a wake card. (Impulse goes back to A) A passes. B attempts to block (0 intercept). (Impulse goes back to A) A passes. B plays an other wake card. (Impulse goes back to A) A passes. B passes. => action is blocked
Is 6) legal?

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Unless both wake cards say that you must block the action, yes, this is perfectly legal. You can play WWEF, OtQV and Forced Awakening all three on the same action and add one that says you must block the action on top of that.

Jussi Hattara
Webmaster Extraordinaire
Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> A is controlled by the acting Methuselah, B is controlled by his prey and is tapped.
> A bleeds (0 stealth). A passes. B plays a wake card. (Impulse goes back to A) A passes. B attempts to block (0 intercept). (Impulse goes back to A) A passes. B plays an other wake card. (Impulse goes back to A) A passes. B passes. All others pass => action is blocked
> Is 6) legal?
>
Yes. Nothing forbids it. Also: Telepthic Counter is usable in step 6 (by the blocking vampire or by any other minion B has who can play it).
Step 9 is necessary (important for stuff such as Babble or Maris Streck).
